name: Haonan-100/SF311-Citizen-Service-Requests-Local-Data-Pipeline-and-Analytics
what_it_holds: End-to-end pipeline ingesting >7.6M San Francisco 311 service-request records (2008-2025) via the Socrata API into PostgreSQL with Metabase dashboards. Data itself is git-ignored (not committed); pipeline/config code only. Top complaint types are generic (bulky-item pickup, cleaning) with no Airbnb/STR-specific handling shown.
why_useful: SF is one of the three target cities (SF 311/OSTR). Provides a ready, long-history (17-year) one-command pull method for SF's full 311 feed, from which STR/short-term-rental complaint categories could be isolated to build an enforcement-activity proxy.
size_hint: ~7.6M rows / ~700MB CSV snapshot, not committed to repo
themes: Short-term-rental insurance/incident, noise complaint and 311 datasets mentioning Airbnb (NYC 311, LA MyLA311, SF 311) as enforcement/activity proxies
why_all: SF is one of the three target cities (SF 311/OSTR). Provides a ready, long-history (17-year) one-command pull method for SF's full 311 feed, from which STR/short-term-rental complaint categories could be isolated to build an enforcement-activity proxy.

name: ollieiris95/nyc-311-noise-analysis
what_it_holds: Python/SQL study of NYC 311 noise complaints; committed raw file '311_noise_complaints_2024.csv' (raw_data folder) covering calendar year 2024 only, with date/time, complaint type, borough, and geolocation fields. No Airbnb or STR linkage in the documentation.
why_useful: Noise complaints are a commonly proposed proxy for short-term-rental party/turnover activity in dense neighborhoods, but this repo is single-year, city-wide (not STR-filtered) and would need substantial rework to isolate an Airbnb-adjacent signal.

name: chile-night-lights-change
what_it_holds: VIIRS Black Marble (VNP46A3) nighttime-lights change analysis for Chile across 2014, 2019, 2024: annual composites, deltas, and regional (region-level) metrics. Repo description implies committed regional summary outputs, not just a notebook, but file listing was not independently confirmed.
why_useful: Chile is one of the LatAm markets named in gap #7 (regional travel volume outside US/EU: LatAm — Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, and by extension Chile). name: Dublin Inquirer GitHub org (checked, no STR registry repo found)
what_it_holds: Verified: this org (Dublin's investigative local newspaper, known for reporting on Ireland's Register of Short-Term Lettings) has only 4 public repos -- dublininquirer-com (site code), counciltracker-ie (council motions/votes tracker, forked from civictech-ie), you-draw-it (D3/TypeScript interactive-prediction visualization tool), and voter-guide-2024. No Airbnb/STR-register scraper or dataset is publicly on this org despite their STR reporting.
why_useful: Negative result worth recording so a future scout does not re-check the same lead: the Irish Register of Short-Term Lettings does not have a public GitHub scraper/mirror under this org. counciltracker-ie (forked from civictech-ie) may be worth a separate regulatory-tooling look for other Irish civic-data trackers, but it is not STR-specific.
